record.paper_title: Open problems on Steiner trees and maximal distance minimizers
record.original_question: For d>2 and a full Steiner tree S_t⊂R^d, what is the maximum possible normalized length H1(S_t∩B_{tr}(x))/r for t∈(0,1)?

evidence.quote: Question 2.7. Let S_t⊂R^d for d > 2. Additionally assume that S_t is full. What is the maximum of H1(S_t∩B_tr(x))/r for t∈(0,1)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 3$ and let $S\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a full Steiner tree, that is, a connected set of finite one-dimensional Hausdorff measure that is a local length minimizer connecting a finite set of terminals, in which every terminal has degree 1 and every non-terminal branching point (Steiner point) has degree 3 with the three incident edges meeting at $120^\circ$ angles. For $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$, $r>0$, and $t\in(0,1)$, let $B_{tr}(x)$ denote the closed Euclidean ball of radius $tr$ centered at $x$, and consider the normalized length
$$\Phi(S,x,r,t) := \frac{\mathcal{H}^1\!\left(S\cap B_{tr}(x)\right)}{r},$$
where $\mathcal{H}^1$ is the 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Determine
$$\sup\bigl\{\Phi(S,x,r,t) : S\subset\mathbb{R}^d \text{ a full Steiner tree},\ x\in\mathbb{R}^d,\ r>0\bigr\}$$
as a function of $t\in(0,1)$ and the dimension $d\ge 3$.
artifact.category_tag: Steiner trees and geometric measure theory
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent (November 2025) compilation of open problems on Steiner trees and maximal distance minimizers. While related Ahlfors–David regularity bounds for Steiner trees are known, no sharp value for this maximum normalized length in dimension d>2 appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on Steiner trees and maximal distance minimizers
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems concerning Steiner trees and maximal distance minimizers, including density-type questions.
status_evidence.claim: The maximum of H^1(S_t∩B_{tr}(x))/r for full Steiner trees in R^d with d>2 is listed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Universal Ahlfors–David regularity of Steiner trees
status_evidence.snippet: Proves Ahlfors–David regularity for Steiner trees with constants depending only on dimension.
status_evidence.claim: Related upper bounds on H^1 of Steiner trees in balls exist but are not sharp.
